questions.question:
D1 — Add gstack skill routing rules to this project's CLAUDE.md?
Project/branch/task: gstack-autoplan-chain-aarN51 on main, about to /autoplan the User Dashboard plan.
ELI10: gstack works best when your project's CLAUDE.md includes skill routing rules. Right now this repo has no CLAUDE.md, so future sessions won't know to route "review this plan" to /autoplan or "fix this bug" to /investigate. Adding a short routing section means the assistant picks the right skill automatically instead of you typing slash commands each time. This is a one-time prompt per project.
Stakes if we pick wrong: Skip it and future sessions default to generic behavior and you invoke skills by hand; add it and you get one small committed file in the repo root.
Recommendation: A because routing rules are cheap, reversible, and make every later session sharper.
Note: options differ in kind, not coverage — no completeness score.
Net: a 15-line committed CLAUDE.md section vs. manual skill invocation forever. Note: in plan mode the file write and commit will be applied after this review completes, not now. <gstack-qid:routing-injection>

options.label: Add routing rules (recommended)
options.description:
✅ Future sessions auto-route requests to the right gstack skill without slash commands
✅ Creates CLAUDE.md with a committed, reviewable 15-line section you can edit any time
❌ Adds one new file and one chore commit to the repo (applied after plan mode exits)

options.label: No thanks, manual skills
options.description:
✅ Repo stays untouched; no CLAUDE.md or extra commit lands in your history
✅ You keep full control over when skills run by typing them yourself
❌ Every future session must be told which skill to use; this prompt will not re-appear
